description: This file defines the I18NImportError entity class for the OrangeHRM project. It maps to the 'ohrm_i18n_import_error' database table and includes properties for related language string, language, error, and importer, with associated getter and setter methods. It utilizes Doctrine ORM for mapping and incorporates a Decorator trait.

classes.name: I18NImportError
classes.description: Entity class representing import errors related to internationalization strings in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for associated language string, language, error, and the employee who imported the data, with ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the import error record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique ID of the import error record.

methods.name: getLangString
methods.description: Retrieves the associated language string entity.

methods.name: setLangString
methods.description: Associates a language string entity with this error record.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the language entity associated with the error.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language entity for the error record.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Gets the error entity associated with this import error.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Associates an error entity with this import error.

methods.name: getImportedBy
methods.description: Returns the employee who imported the record.

methods.name: setImportedBy
methods.description: Sets the employee who imported the record.
